plain_summary: The model does not reveal who was in its training data beyond chance level.
recommendation: Reduce overfitting (regularisation, fewer trees, early stopping) or train with differential privacy, then re-run this test.
summary: Loss-threshold attack (Yeom et al., 2018) on 3660 training and 3660 held-out rows: attack AUC 0.567 (limit 0.6), membership advantage 0.134. Mean loss 0.307 on training rows vs 0.493 on held-out rows.
title: Membership-inference risk
